verdict_summary: CONDITIONAL NO-GO FOR REAL MONEY: research governance is mature, but real-time risk control, ledger/reconciliation, operations, and counterparty/compliance controls are not built.
top_findings: Two-layer capital is currently governance intent, not physical account/API/margin isolation.
Decision Gateway, Risk Engine, Position Registry, and Reconciliation are not implemented; small real-money trading must not start without them.
Ledger/reconciliation must be built before live trading; tax reporting can be semi-manual only if raw statements and NAV snapshots are automatically archived.
Counterparty, KYC, withdrawal freeze, API key, and China/offshore exchange compliance risks are recognized only weakly and need hard phase gates.
Operations still lacks a concrete alert owner, runbook, takeover, daily close, and recovery drill model.
better_alternatives: Implement minimum viable real-time risk control before any real money: gateway-only order path, DB-authoritative positions, pre-trade hard gates, post-trade reconciliation, periodic risk scans, and kill switch.
Physically isolate core and fence capital: keep core off exchange, use independent subaccount/API for fence, disable withdrawals, whitelist IPs, and prohibit auto top-up.
Implement minimum ledger: raw exchange statements, ledger entries, daily UTC NAV, PnL attribution, and three-way exchange/DB/runtime reconciliation.
Add counterparty/compliance register as a Phase 1 hard dependency before Phase 2 live funds.
Define minimum viable operations: P0/P1/P2 alerts, owner, runbook, daily close, and monthly incident drills.
notes: No Holdout read. Did not use other A1/A2/A4 audit conclusions as evidence. External compliance sources were checked only for risk framing and are not legal/tax advice.
